meta.title: LearnGeeta · Swarnim Varg — The 50th Golden Batch
meta.description: Celebrate the 50th Golden Batch of LearnGeeta. Join the Swarnim Varg competitions — Geeta Chitrakala, Geeta Swar, Geeta Gyan Challenge, Geeta Expression and Vivechan Reel.

hero.description: The 50th batch of LearnGeeta — the Golden Batch — begins soon. To mark this milestone, we invite you to a grand worldwide celebration of the Bhagavad Geeta through five divine competitions, open to every age.
hero.ctaNote: No entry fee · Open to every age · Closes in September
hero.shortDescription: Celebrate the Swarnim Varg of LearnGeeta with 5 exciting competitions

about.imageAlt: Shri Krishna in meditation at sunrise
about.bodyLead: LearnGeeta's 50th special batch is a journey of
about.bodyTail: To honour this milestone, the Swarnim Varg brings a festival of competitions celebrating the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Geeta.
points: Five global competitions — painting, recitation, quiz, reflection and creative editing
Categories for children, youth and adults — everyone participates
Certificates and recognition for all participants
Guided by the Geeta Pariwar tradition of seva and swadhyay

competitions.description: Choose your path of expression — paint, recite, answer, reflect or create. Every competition is an offering to the wisdom of the Geeta.

items.name: Geeta Chitrakala
items.subtitle: Global Drawing & Painting Competition
items.description: Express the wisdom of the Geeta through handmade drawing and painting. Create one final physical artwork and let your colours speak the shlokas.
highlights: Handmade physical artwork — one final entry per participant
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · participation certificate for valid entries

items.name: Geeta Swar
items.subtitle: Shloka · Meaning · Life Application Challenge
items.description: Recite a shloka, share its meaning and its application in your life — as a 60–180 second public Instagram Reel.
highlights: Multiple reels allowed — your highest-reach eligible reel is final
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · participation certificate for valid entries

items.name: Geeta Gyan Challenge
items.subtitle: 50 Questions · 18 Chapters · One Golden Challenge
items.description: A grand online quiz spanning all 18 chapters of the Bhagavad Geeta — 50 questions, 35 minutes, one scored attempt.
highlights: Top 3 excellence · Top 10 merit · participation certificate at 50%+ score

items.name: Geeta Expression
items.subtitle: 60-sec Personal Reflection Challenge
items.description: Share a heartfelt 60-second personal reflection on how the Geeta touches your life, as a public Instagram Reel.
highlights: Ideal 60 sec, max 90 sec — multiple reels allowed
Top 3 per age group · Top 10 merit · one participation certificate per valid participant

items.name: Vivechan Reel
items.subtitle: Creative Edit Challenge
items.description: Craft a 30–60 second creative edit from the approved Vivechan Timestamp Bank and publish it as a public Instagram Reel.
items.window: Create 4 – 16 Sep · Publish 17 – 18 Sep · cut-off 25 Sep
highlights: 30–60 sec reel from the approved Timestamp Bank · master MP4 required
Overall Top 3 · up to Top 50 merit · participation certificate for valid entries

ctaCard.description: One account opens the door to every Swarnim Varg competition.

why.description: Every shloka memorised, every essay written and every colour placed on canvas draws you closer to the eternal song of Shri Krishna. Walk this journey with thousands of fellow seekers of the Geeta Pariwar.

benefits.title: Recognition & Prizes
benefits.description: Winners honoured at the grand Swarnim Varg ceremony.

benefits.title: Certificates for All
benefits.description: Every participant receives a certificate of participation.

benefits.title: Divine Wisdom
benefits.description: Deepen your bond with the Bhagavad Geeta's teachings.

benefits.title: A Global Family
benefits.description: Connect with the worldwide LearnGeeta community.

finalCta.description: A golden opportunity awaits you. Register today and celebrate the 50th batch of LearnGeeta with the whole pariwar.
